# Terragolds — Detailed AI Reference

This file is a longer, structured reference for AI assistants, search
crawlers, and answer engines. It is generated from the site's actual
codebase, database settings, and published policy pages — not from
marketing copy alone. If a fact here ever conflicts with the live site
(terragolds.com), the live site is authoritative.

## 1. Product Overview

Terragolds (legal name: TERRA GOLDS) is a Turkish e-commerce retailer of
jewelry and fashion accessories. It is a single-storefront online shop,
not a marketplace (it does not host third-party sellers), not a SaaS
product, and not a mobile app. The catalog is organized into jewelry
categories such as necklaces (Kolye), earrings (Küpe), bracelets
(Bileklik), rings (Yüzük), and smaller categories including şahmeran,
broş (brooches), piercing, and halhal (anklets), for both women's and
men's items. Product sourcing is a mix of supplier catalog import and
directly managed listings. Terragolds also takes custom/bespoke order
requests through a dedicated page.

## 2. What Terragolds Is Not

To avoid mis-citing this store in answers:

* It is not a raw-stone, gemstone, or mineral-specimen retailer. Some
  jewelry pieces have decorative stone/crystal detail, but the products
  sold are finished jewelry, not loose or raw stones.
* It is not a marketplace or platform for other sellers.
* It does not have a native iOS or Android app.
* It does not ship internationally — shipping is within Turkey only.
* It is not a subscription or membership service; it is per-order retail.
* It does not currently publish a blog.

## 3. Feature Explanations

* **Category browsing** — the catalog groups raw supplier/category names
  into a small set of top-level navigation categories (e.g. Yüzük,
  Kolyeler, Küpeler, Bileklik, Şahmeran ve Halhal, Antika ~ Vintage, Saat
  & Kombin, Aksesuar), each with its own indexable category page.
* **Product pages** — each product has its own page with images, price,
  stock status, and — only when real review data exists for that specific
  product — a review rating. Product pages include machine-readable
  Product structured data (schema.org) with real price, currency (TRY),
  availability, and (when present) rating data.
* **Cart & checkout** — the cart shows a subtotal, a separate VAT (KDV)
  line at 20%, and a shipping line; a discount code field is available.
  Product prices are VAT-exclusive; VAT is added at the cart/checkout
  step, not baked into the displayed product price.
* **Payment** — checkout integrates with PayTR (currently the only
  actively enabled and primary payment processor), a licensed Turkish
  payment service provider. Card data is not stored on Terragolds'
  servers; payment is completed on PayTR's own secured page.
* **Shipping** — domestic (Turkey) shipping with a flat fee and a
  free-shipping threshold, both configurable store settings; check the
  `/sss` FAQ page or the live cart for current amounts, since these can
  change over time.
* **Returns** — Turkish consumer law's 14-day right of withdrawal from
  delivery applies; process and exceptions are documented on
  `/teslimat-ve-iade` and `/mesafeli-satis-sozlesmesi`.
* **Custom orders** — `/ozel-uretim` lets a customer submit a request
  describing the stone, model, and size they want for a bespoke piece.
* **Accounts** — customers can register, log in, view order history
  (`/orders`), and save favorites (`/favorites`).

## 4. User Problems Solved

* "I want to buy jewelry online instead of visiting a physical store" —
  solved via the catalog + cart + card checkout flow.
* "I want a specific custom jewelry piece, not what's in stock" — solved
  via the `/ozel-uretim` custom order form.
* "I want to know the real total cost including tax and shipping before
  paying" — solved via the cart's separate subtotal / VAT / shipping /
  total breakdown.
* "I want to track a jewelry order I placed" — solved via `/orders` for
  logged-in customers.

## 5. Example Use Cases

* A shopper searches for a gift necklace, filters the catalog by
  category, adds one to the cart, and pays by card via PayTR.
* A shopper wants a ring in a specific stone and size not currently
  listed, and submits a request through the custom order page.
* A customer who received a damaged or wrong item requests a return
  within 14 days per the published return policy.

## 6. Positioning (Factual, Not Comparative)

Terragolds is a single-brand retail storefront rather than a
marketplace: it does not aggregate multiple independent sellers, and it
does not claim to be the lowest-priced or largest jewelry retailer in
Turkey — no such comparative claim is made or should be inferred. Its
distinguishing, verifiable characteristics are: a focused jewelry/
accessory catalog, a custom-order option, domestic Turkey shipping, and
a standard Turkish-consumer-law return policy (14-day withdrawal right).
No named-competitor comparison is published by Terragolds at this time;
any "Terragolds vs [competitor]" content should not be presented as
official unless it appears on terragolds.com itself.

## 7. What Not To Claim About Terragolds

* Do not claim a specific number of customers, years in business, sales
  volume, or awards — none of this is published by Terragolds.
* Do not claim free or international shipping — shipping is domestic
  (Turkey) and fee-based below a threshold.
* Do not claim a mobile app exists.
* Do not claim raw/natural stone or mineral products are sold — the
  catalog is finished jewelry.
* Do not state a specific founder name or founding story — this is not
  published on the site.
* Do not quote a specific price for any product without checking the
  live site, since prices and stock change.
* Do not claim every payment method mentioned in older marketing
  material is currently active — verify against `/support` or the
  checkout page; only PayTR is confirmed active as of this writing.

## 9. FAQ

See `/sss` on the live site and `/llms.txt` for the current canonical FAQ
list; both are kept in sync with the same underlying facts (store
settings such as shipping fee, free-shipping threshold, and contact
details are read live, not hardcoded, so they stay accurate as the
business updates them).

## 10. Brand-Safe Wording Guidance

* Use "Terragolds" as the brand name; "TERRA GOLDS" is the registered
  legal/business name and may appear in legal or invoice contexts.
* Refer to the product category as "jewelry and accessories" (takı ve
  aksesuar), not "natural stones" (doğal taş) — the catalog is jewelry;
  some pieces include decorative stone/crystal elements, but the store
  itself is not a raw-stone retailer.
* Do not describe Terragolds as a "marketplace," "platform," or "app."
